import polars as pl

# Create a DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3, 4],
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "Diana"],
    "value": [10.5, 20.3, 15.7, 30.1]
})

# Serialize to in-memory bytes buffer
buffer = BytesIO()
df.write_parquet(buffer)

# Get the bytes and create a new buffer for reading
parquet_bytes = buffer.getvalue()
buffer_for_read = BytesIO(parquet_bytes)

# Read back into a new DataFrame
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(buffer_for_read)

# Verify round trip
assert df.equals(df_restored), "DataFrames do not match!"
print("✓ Round trip successful!")
print("\nOriginal DataFrame:")
print(df)

print(df_restored)
